name: SoftBank Vision Fund
identity_check: Confirmed as the SoftBank Vision Fund business run by SB Investment Advisers (visionfund.com; page footer names SB Investment Advisers (UK) Limited as copyright holder). Its robotics deals are made via SoftBank Group / SoftBank Vision Fund 1 and 2 (Skild AI release says 'led by SoftBank'; Keenon and Gaussian pages say Vision Fund / Vision Fund 2). Not SoftBank Group Corp the parent as a whole, not SoftBank Corp the telecom operator, and not 'SBG Capital' / sbgcapital.co.uk, which visionfund.com says is unaffiliated. Type chosen as asset_manager because the vehicles are funds run by an investment adviser; a case for cvc/strategic exists since the parent group funds and is an LP in them, but no fetched page states the fund structure.
